title: Continuous functors preserve hypercoverings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file hypercovering.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For a continuous functor u : D -> C commuting with fibre products, u(K) is a hypercovering of u(Y): u sends coverings to coverings by the definition of a continuous functor - a stronger notion than a morphism of sites, which is why this is easier than lemma-hypercovering-morphism-sites; it remains to check that u commutes with the limits used in defining (cosk_n sk_n K)_{n+1} for n >= 1, which holds because the induced functor D/Y -> C/X commutes with all finite limits (both slices have finite limits by categories-lemma-finite-limits-exist).
